tools.name: format_spec
tools.description: Returns the ConsoleMouse profile format (profile-v1 1.32.0): a quick reference for writing profiles and macros, one section of the specification (import_code: the CMP2 import code and the older CM1 share code), or the JSON Schema. Read-only; returns published documentation.

tools.name: format_examples
tools.description: Lists the published base profiles (accessibility templates), example profiles and invalid examples with their expected validator message; with an id, returns that file. Read-only.

tools.name: profile_validate
tools.description: Checks a ConsoleMouse profile (full or derived), an import envelope or an import code (CMP2, or the older CM1) against the JSON Schema and every format rule, including the macro limits. Returns valid or a list of issues with the path to fix. Read-only; nothing is stored.

tools.name: profile_describe
tools.description: Returns a plain-language preview of a valid ConsoleMouse profile: for a derived profile one sentence per change against its base (keys, macros, press once, mouse movement), for a full profile one sentence per key. Languages: de, en, es, fr, it, pl, pt-BR. Read-only.

tools.name: profile_import_code
tools.description: Checks a derived ConsoleMouse profile and returns an import code (CMP2) the person pastes into ConsoleMouse under Games > Import profile or in the AI Workshop (Import code), with the plain-language preview and the import steps. A full profile is accepted when base_profile_id names its base. Use form

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: format_examples, profile_validate · Private data: format_examples · Public sink: format_spec · Destructive: format_spec, format_examples, profile_validate, profile_import_code.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: format_examples, profile_validate · Private data: format_examples · Public sink: format_spec · Destructive: format_spec, format_examples, profile_validate, profile_import_code

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
